conclusion: NormalEnemy.UpdateThink calls BoostActionCheck, which sets BP to zero with Use=true when full. BattleEnemyBP then rerolls BoostMax. Pirro overrides the boss AI hooks and neither calls nor inherits NormalEnemy; his scripted charged orders are separate. Preserve initialization BP draws, but no automatic threshold reroll at full BP.
